fomod.Name: Placeable LMGs
fomod.Author: Queen-Jadwiga
fomod.Description: Place, operate and pick up supported base PKM and MG42 emplacements. PKM requires GAMMA only. MG42 additionally requires the MG-42/MG-3 addon from Hisalute's Weapon Packs Repacked; other addons from that pack are not required. MG3 mounting is not supported.
